date_check: NOT IN THIS EDITION: Jesse Jackson died on 17 February 2026, not today.
Voyager 1 crossed the one-light-day line on 18 Nov; today is its first full day beyond it.
The Van Gogh hammer fell on Wednesday evening in New York; the record was first reported on Thursday.
No joint statement had been issued from the Shenzhen trilateral by press time.
GTA VI has no PC version announced; Rockstar gave no launch sales figure.
